title: Sailing San Francisco
includes: Life vest, captain, and all the seawater you need is included!

gap: 1 week cancellation policy. If you cancel or reschedule less than 1 week, your credit card will be charged the full amount. If it rains during the time of your charter, we won't go out and there won't be any charges. However, if it's just chilly or windy, we will still go out sailing.
